title: Layer bộ phận cho puppet rig (decision 050): Heo Rừng, Heo Rùa, Cá Betta, Bạch Tuộc
note: Mỗi con 3 sheet: bộ phận rời (như bộ rối giấy cắt sẵn, mỗi bộ phận vẽ trọn vẹn), mắt + miệng nghỉ, các miệng còn lại. Ảnh 2 = ảnh hiện tại của con đó (giữ nhận diện); ảnh 3 = bản vẽ tạm đang chạy trong game, chỉ để biết ô nào là bộ phận nào. KHÔNG cần căn chỉnh gì: sau khi lưu sheet, Claude chạy art.py cut + scripts/rig/batch.py place tự đặt từng bộ phận về đúng khớp. Thứ tự ưu tiên: B1–B3 (Heo Rừng) → T1–T3 → F1–F3 → O1–O3.

sheets.title: Wild Boar Pig (pig_boar): bộ phận rời

refs.subject: this exact creature (Wild Boar Pig) as it already is in my game
which body part goes in which cell and its rough shape (a flat placeholder drawing of the same parts)

rows: the BODY alone: an egg-shaped furry trunk with the light belly and back spots, no head, no legs, no tail; its front end is painted complete (normally hidden under the head)
the HEAD alone: a big round furry head seen three-quarter to the right, with the cheek blush, but NO eyes, NO mouth, NO snout, NO ears (blank face)
the SNOUT alone: the pink snout disc with two nostrils and the two small cream tusks curving up from its lower edge
the MANE alone: the tuft of dark-brown spiky bristles that runs along the nape, as one piece
one EAR alone: pointed brown ear standing up, pink inside, with a short rounded base
one FRONT LEG alone: a short straight leg with a dark hoof, standing straight down, a rounded top
one BACK LEG alone: a short straight hind leg with a dark hoof, standing straight down, a rounded top

the TAIL alone: a thin tail with a small tuft of dark bristles at the tip, drawn perfectly STRAIGHT and HORIZONTAL like a ribbon laid flat, its base (where it joins the body) at the LEFT end and its tip at the RIGHT end
extra: All cells are separate BODY PARTS of ONE creature, like a cut-out puppet kit laid out flat: Wild Boar Pig: a brown boar piglet with a spiky dark-brown mane along its nape, light spots on its back, a pink snout with two small cream tusks curving up, pointed ears, short legs with dark hooves. Keep every part IDENTICAL to image 2 in colours, markings, line and proportions, as if cut out of that very picture.

Draw each part COMPLETE and whole, as if the other parts had been taken away: the area normally hidden behind other parts is painted too. Every part in a calm neutral rest position, seen three-quarter from the side, the creature facing RIGHT.
sheets.framing: A cut-out puppet kit sheet: each cell holds exactly ONE separate body part, centred, filling about 70 % of the cell. No other body around it, no joints, no pins, no shadow, no effects, no text.

refs.subject: this exact creature (Wild Boar Pig): its eyes and mouth are what to draw
which expression goes in which cell (a flat placeholder drawing)

rows: the EYES open: big round shiny eyes with two white highlights
the EYES half-closed, sleepy
the EYES closed: two gentle curved lines
the EYES angry: determined round eyes under frowning brows
the EYES hurt: squeezed shut like > < with one small cartoon tear
the EYES dizzy: cartoon spirals
the EYES happy: closed upward curves ^ ^

extra: Every cell shows ONLY a piece of the face of the creature in image 2 (Wild Boar Pig), floating alone exactly as it sits on its face in three-quarter view facing right: no head, no snout, no skin around it.

The eye cells show two eyes side by side (the far eye a little smaller and closer to the middle); every eye cell has the SAME size and the SAME spacing so they can be swapped one for another. The mouth cells are small, all the SAME size.
Same line and colours as image 2's eyes and mouth.
